exposure: Implementation of standard protocols in obstetrics and gynecology
Before implementation of standard protocols (group A)
standard protocols in obstetrics and gynecology
After implementation of standard protocols (group B)
cohort: Patients in the obstetrics (n=829) and gynecology (n=221) departments of a teaching hospital
finding: The implementation of standard protocols in obstetrics and gynecology led to significant reductions in anemia, blood transfusions, and the use and cost of antimicrobial therapy.
mod_finding: In obstetrics, the use of AMT for >24 hours significantly decreased in both vaginal and cesarean deliveries after the implementation of standard protocols.
